headline: Prim Estudio orients low-slung house for viewing Argentinian countryside
context: Local studio Prim Estudio has designed a white house with a balcony inset into an asymmetrical zinc roof and arched windows for contemplating the landscape outside Buenos Aires, Argentina. Known as Los Tigres, the 187-square-metre house sits on an expansive property in Villa Rosa

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Local studio Prim Estudio has designed a white house with a balcony inset into an asymmetrical zinc roof and arched windows for contemplating the landscape outside Buenos Aires, Argentina. Known as Los Tigres, the 187-square-metre house sits on an expansive property in Villa Rosa, on the banks of the Luján River.
